31792-F.s: The bill amends the 2008 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) to reflect the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota), raising the expenditure and revenue figures under article 1 from 25,241 to 44,241 thousand euros. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

31924-I.s: The bill amends the 2008 budget statement of the Royal Household (Huis der Koningin) by adjusting its appropriations, including a supplementary and closing budget adjustment. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the Royal Household (I) for the year 2008 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Huis der Koningin (I) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31924-XVIII.s: This bill sets the final budget adjustments (slotwetmutaties) for the 2008 Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration budget chapter, changing commitments, expenditure and revenue per policy article and for the Rijksgebouwendienst. It also allows the 2008 annual report to present certain budget information in a reduced or non-article-specific form.
q: Notwithstanding Article 54(3) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the annual report of the Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration budget chapter for 2008 does not include the information referred to in that paragraph per policy article.

In afwijking van artikel 54, derde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt in het jaarverslag van het begrotingshoofdstuk Wonen, Wijken en Integratie (XVIII) voor het jaar 2008 de informatie, bedoeld in dat artikellid, niet per beleidsartikel opgenomen.
p: Article 2 relaxes the statutory requirement for article-level information in the annual report, letting the minister link information to self-designated policy priorities instead.

31965-D.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Economic Structure Enhancement Fund (FES), adjusting expenditure and receipts in line with the Spring Memorandum 2009. The explanatory memorandum describes reallocations of funds between articles 13 and 15 and between budget lines for transport, environment, knowledge and innovation, and spatial planning, without delegating rule-making power.
31965-D.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by reference to the Aanvullend Beleidsakkoord and reallocation of unused funds from earlier budget years, not by any new power.
q: In addition, the amendment concerns the transfer of funds from article 15 Projects in preparation to article 13 Knowledge and innovation.
Daarnaast betreft de mutatie de overboeking van middelen van artikel 15 Projecten in voorbereiding naar artikel 13 Kennis en innovatie

32022.s: The bill amends the Drank- en Horecawet to curb alcohol use among young people and alcohol-related public disorder, while reducing administrative burdens. It shifts supervision from the national Voedsel en Waren Autoriteit to municipalities, makes the mayor the competent authority instead of the college of mayor and aldermen, grants municipalities new regulatory powers, and adds an experimental article allowing higher age limits in designated municipalities.
32022.j: The memorandum justifies the new municipal powers and the experiment by local problems with youth alcohol use and by the desire to bring governance closer to citizens; the abolition of inspectorate oversight is justified as consistent with the Oosting committee's recommendation to move from specific to generic oversight.
q: Municipalities get more options to shape alcohol policy at local level, particularly to counter excessive alcohol use among young people.
Gemeenten krijgen meer mogelijkheden om op lokaal niveau beter invulling te geven aan het alcoholbeleid, met name om overmatig alcoholgebruik onder jongeren tegen te gaan.
d: municipal ordinance rules for paracommercial organisations
municipal ordinances banning or restricting alcohol sales, age limits, and price promotions
designation of experimental municipalities with higher age limit of 18
allocation of supervisory tasks among inspectors
p: Licence withdrawal and suspension powers are expanded for the mayor, including grounds tied to integrity assessments.
The mayor may impose a sales ban of one to twelve weeks on businesses after three violations, subject to a hardship exception.
Administrative fines are expanded to the mayor and the minister for a wider set of provisions.
Supervisory powers move from the national inspectorate to municipal officials, with abolition of specific interbestuurlijk toezicht over municipalities.
Introduces a criminal offence for under-16s possessing alcohol in public, limiting individual freedom.

parties: Supports lifting administrative burdens but questions whether shifting burdens to local level cancels out relief; prefers local discretion within national frameworks and questions the mandatory three-strikes sanction for supermarkets.
Is there such a shift of burdens from national to local level that, net, it yields no burden relief for the businesses and institutions involved?
Is er sprake van zodanige lastenverschuiving van nationaal niveau naar lokaal niveau dat dat netto voor de betrokken bedrijven en instellingen geen lastenverlichting oplevert?
Asks why price promotions and supermarket sanctions are left to municipalities rather than national rules, and how enforcement and rights-consistency will be ensured.
Why, despite lack of support, was another option chosen?
Waarom wordt, ondanks gebrek aan draagvlak, toch voor een andere mogelijkheid gekozen?
Worries the bill focuses on repression over prevention and gives mayors broad powers; asks why the advertising definition was dropped and questions the scope of local regulation.
In themselves these members find this understandable, since alcohol can play a role in street safety.
Op zichzelf vinden deze leden dit begrijpelijk, aangezien alcohol een rol kan spelen in de veiligheid op straat.

Questions whether decentralisation will work and asks the government to await pilot outcomes before the vote; also asks about the EU-law compatibility of price-promotion rules and the scope of the experimental clause.
Does the government share the VVD members' view that achieving the bill's objectives largely depends on the success of decentralisation?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de VVD-fractie dat het behalen van de doelstellingen van de wetswijziging voor een groot deel afhankelijk is van het succes van decentralisatie?
Welcomes municipal regulatory powers and criminalisation of youth possession, but asks why the age limit is not uniformly raised to 18 and how local discretion will be checked.
Questions the democratic legitimacy of extra powers for mayors, the collegiality principle being set aside, and asks for evaluation of local pilots before adoption.
How does this additional power relate to the democratic legitimacy of mayors?
Hoe verhoudt deze extra bevoegdheid zich met de democratische legitimiteit van burgemeesters?

Warns that accumulating powers at mayors without coherence across laws increases pressure and vulnerability; demands national guidelines rather than local dependence and asks for an overview of mayoral powers.
There is a danger that tackling extreme youth alcohol use now becomes too dependent on local political will.
Het gevaar is aanwezig dat de aanpak van het extreme alcoholgebruik van jongeren nu te zeer afhankelijk wordt van de lokale politieke wil.
Questions whether municipal power to ban price promotions and link access ages to closing times will shift drinking elsewhere and create inequality between municipalities.
The bill gives municipalities the power to prohibit price promotions in the catering sector (article 25d).
Het wetsvoorstel geeft gemeenten de bevoegdheid prijsacties in de horeca te verbieden (artikel 25d).
Worries that making the three-strikes sanction discretionary for mayors turns it into a paper tiger and shifts the burden onto minors rather than sellers.
These members foresee that the three-strikes-out principle will become a paper tiger in this way.
Deze leden voorzien dat het «three strikes out» principe op deze wijze een papier tijger wordt.
Supports shifting enforcement to municipalities and removing mandatory sanctions to limit mayors' liability, but wants national rules on promotions and wants the age-18 experiment kept.
These members can agree that the mayor no longer has to impose these mandatory sanctions.
Genoemde leden kunnen het eens zijn met het feit dat de burgemeester niet langer deze verplichte sancties hoeft op te leggen.
Objects to dropping mandatory sanctions and the age-18 experiment, and questions whether decentralised enforcement and mayors' independence can be guaranteed.
Welcomes broader mayoral discretion on sanctions but asks for evidence on effectiveness and how enforcement will be carried out given the shift to local supervision.
It is therefore difficult for these members to assess to what extent this additional enforcement instrument actually contributes to reducing alcohol misuse among young people.
Het is daarom lastig voor deze leden om te beoordelen in hoeverre dit extra handhavinginstrument daadwerkelijk bijdraagt aan vermindering van alcoholmisbruik onder jongeren.
Disappointed by weakened enforcement and removal of the experiment article, and asks how quality of local supervisors will be guaranteed.
These members ask about the transfer of responsibility for supervising compliance with the Drank- en Horecawet to the municipality.
Genoemde leden vragen naar de overgang van de verantwoordelijkheid voor het toezicht op de naleving van de Drank- en Horecawet naar de gemeente.
Asks why the mandatory sanction was turned into a mayoral discretion and whether supermarkets will feel less risk of closure.
The SGP members ask the government why it considers it necessary to change the mandatory nature of article 19a into a power of the mayor.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering waarom zij het nodig vindt om het verplichtende karakter van artikel 19a te wijzigen in een bevoegdheid van de burgemeester.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Drank- en Horecawet to curb youth alcohol use and public disorder, raising concerns about the mandatory temporary sales ban (art. 19a) under ECHR art. 6, the proportionality of that sanction, the EG-Verdrag assessment of opening-hours and price-promotion rules, the experimental clause, enforcement gaps for youths, the taxfree shop exception, and the exemption for managers from social hygiene requirements. The government's nader rapport accepted several points (proportionality hardship clause, EG-Verdrag passages, experiment specification partly, taxfree motivation) but rejected the advice to replace the managers' exemption with a ontheffing and declined to specify the experiment further.
concerns: The mandatory temporary sales ban in art. 19a may be punitive under ECHR art. 6 and disproportionate; the government added a hardship exception but kept the sanction mandatory.

Burgemeester has no discretion to consider special circumstances, raising doubts about proportionality of the sales ban; government added a clause allowing waiver where disproportionate harm would result.
The EG-Verdrag assessment of opening-hours rules and price-promotion bans needed supplementing; the memorie was amended accordingly.
The experimental clause lacks specification of purpose and evaluation criteria; the government declined further specification at this stage.

Enforcement gaps: youths buying or possessing alcohol are not directly sanctioned, and the public-road possession ban may not reach the problem; the government argued the possession offence closes the gap.
Taxfree shop exception needed a substantive justification, which the memorie was supplemented with.
Exemption for managers from social hygiene requirements should be done by ontheffing rather than notation on the vergunning; government rejected this to limit administrative burden.

32031.s: The bill amends the Dutch Excise Act (Wet op de accijns) and related tax laws to implement EU Directive 2008/118/EC on excise duties, including new definitions, rules on movement under duty suspension, registered consignees and senders, and EMCS electronic documents. It also shifts the timing and collection rules for excise, mainly to align with EU requirements.
32031.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement the EU directive and the EMCS system and to set technical conditions by general administrative order or ministerial regulation.
q: This bill provides for the implementation of this directive into Dutch law.
Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in de implementatie van deze richtlijn in het Nederlandse recht.
d: Artikel I, B (art. 1a), lid 1 onder q / art. 2 lid 10
further rules implementing excise definitions and uitslag tot verbruik
conditions and restrictions on use of mineral oils as fuel in excise warehouses
conditions for movement of excise goods between warehouses and registered consignees
quantity threshold for presumption of commercial purpose
obligations of persons holding goods for commercial purposes
Artikel I, O (art. 50a lid 4) and R (art. 50d lid 5)
rules on registration of consignees and senders
administration and supervision requirements for registered senders
designation of cases where excise is levied from another warehouse holder
conditions for exemption on airports and ports for travellers
Artikel I, II (art. 69 lid 1 onder d, lid 2)
conditions for exemption from excise for diplomatic, international and treaty uses
rules on refund of excise paid in another member state
p: Rules allocate excise liability for irregularities during cross-border movements, with the inspector deciding on proof and evidentiary time limits, widening administrative discretion over liability.
Artikel I, I (art. 2f) and J (art. 2g, 2h repealed)
Sellers in other member states must appoint a Dutch fiscal representative approved by the inspector, a new administrative gatekeeping role for the tax authority.
Registration as consignee or sender depends on a licence granted at the inspector's discretion, with conditions to be set by general administrative order.
Transporters become jointly liable for excise on goods they carry where an irregularity occurred during their transport.

parties: Asks the government to specify how the Uitvoeringsbesluit and ministerial regulations will be published and what amounts are covered, and whether the EMCS coupling has been tested, reducing executive discretion through clearer rules.
When will the government publish this decision, ask the CDA members?
Wanneer gaat de regering dit besluit publiceren, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie?

Requests itemized EMCS cost figures and cross-country comparisons, and questions the burden on business from the Tax Authority's internet services, seeking transparency on executive spending and implementation.
The VVD members request the government to specify the costs (e.g. what are the construction costs and what are the maintenance costs).
De leden van de VVD-fractie verzoeken de regering de kosten te specificeren (bijv. wat zijn de kosten van de bouw, en wat van het onderhoud).

32040.s: The bill introduces a merger test (fusietoets) across primary, secondary, adult/vocational and higher education, requiring the Minister of Education's prior approval for institutional and governance mergers, supported by a merger impact report and a 13-week decision period. Approval may be withheld if mergers significantly impair educational variety or choice, and approval is deemed granted by operation of law if the Minister fails to decide in time.
32040.j: The memorandum justifies the merger test by the need to safeguard school choice and governance quality, given that existing checks are not strong enough and institutions hold an information advantage.
q: The minister has hardly any powers to check whether in mergers the core values of legitimacy and freedom of choice are sufficiently safeguarded.
De minister heeft nauwelijks bevoegdheden om na te gaan of bij fusies de kernwaarden legitimatie en keuzevrijheid voldoende zijn gewaarborgd.
d: when advice from independent committee is not needed
model form for merger impact report
percentage threshold for school-type share in merger
p: The Minister gains broad discretion to refuse merger approval on open criteria such as significant impairment of educational variety, with only an advisory committee as check.
Where the Minister fails to decide within the statutory period, approval is granted by operation of law, shifting the decision away from ministerial control.(wait)
The Minister may attach conditions to or withdraw an approval deemed granted by operation of law where needed to avert serious harm to the general interest, with compensation for damage.

parties: Asks whether the minister should decide merger tests rather than an independent body like the NMa or an education authority, and questions how parental choice is weighed.
Why does the government depart from the Education Council's advice on this point and set aside the arguments of many actors in the field?
Waarom wijkt de regering op dit terrein van het advies van de Onderwijsraad af en legt zij ook de argumenten van vele spelers in het veld naast zich neer?
Supports the bill as a legal tool to scrutinise mergers and empowering works councils, and asks about a possible defusion procedure and an independent test.
With a merger test the minister can, if freedom of choice is restricted, even block a merger.
Met een fusietoets kan de minister, als de keuzevrijheid wordt beperkt zelfs een fusie tegenhouden.
Welcomes the merger test but asks for a staff and stakeholder consultation requirement and a way to prevent evasion through informal mergers.
Is the government therefore willing to stipulate that a merger can only proceed if two-thirds of staff agree?
Is de regering daarom bereid vast te leggen dat de fusie alleen doorgang kan vinden als tweederde van het personeel instemt?
Questions the legitimacy and open-norm design of the test, warns of juridification and political discretion, and asks why the test is not placed with an independent body.
Will the merger test under the minister's direct responsibility not repeatedly generate political debate about individual mergers?
Zal als gevolg van de fusietoets onder directe verantwoordelijkheid van de minister niet steeds een politiek debat ontstaan over afzonderlijke (afwijzingen van) fusies?
Asks whether execution should sit with an independent body to avoid politicisation and how regional variety is assessed.
to prevent education becoming a plaything of politics, should execution not rather be placed with an independent body?
om te voorkomen dat het onderwijs een speelbal wordt van de politiek, de uitvoering niet juist bij een onafhankelijk instantie moet worden neergelegd
Supports a merger assessment but doubts that blocking mergers always preserves choice and questions the criteria and who applies them.
First, the members ask whether freedom of choice is necessarily guaranteed if a merger is blocked.
Ten eerste vragen de leden of de keuzevrijheid per definitie gewaarborgd blijft als een fusie wordt tegengehouden.
Questions the consistency of the bill, the ministerial discretion over identity and didactics, and whether a notification duty would suffice.
They ask whether it is not precisely the schools themselves who should judge these matters.
Zij vragen of het niet bij uitstek de scholen zelf zijn die hierover een oordeel moeten vellen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the draft bill introducing a merger test in Dutch education should be reconsidered, because the problem it addresses is unclear, the link between school size and quality is not established, and it conflicts with past policy favouring scale. The minister's reply largely rejects the objections, defends the merger test as a safeguard of choice and legitimacy, and accepts several drafting and procedural changes.
concerns: The Afdeling found no clear problem or proven need for a merger test and no proven link between school size and quality, so the bill should be reconsidered.
The Afdeling objected to the fictitious approval (lex silencio positivo) and advised either dropping it or aligning it with the Dienstenwet provision, which the government largely followed.
The Afdeling argued that restricting the constitutional freedom of organisation of schools lacks sufficiently weighty grounds, which the government contested.
The Afdeling noted that the open-ended criteria leave the minister with wide discretion, an argument against the test, which the government defended as necessary at this stage.

The Afdeling advised avoiding double review with the competition authority and limiting the submitted fusion effect report to relevant parts; the government kept the full report but adjusted some points.
The Afdeling made numerous drafting comments on definitions and cross-references across the education acts, largely adopted by the government.

32130.s: This bill (Fiscale vereenvoudigingswet 2010) simplifies Dutch tax laws, including income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, excise and environmental taxes, to cut administrative burdens for citizens and firms and reduce Tax Administration costs. It changes partner definitions, box 3 savings rules, the doorwerkbonus, a new wage-cost scheme for allowances, and procedural rules on provisional assessments, interest and objection.
32130.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical and efficiency-driven, to allow future adjustments of valuation ratios and administrative details without new legislation.
q: To make necessary adjustments easy to implement, the numerical relation between the box 3 valuation, the rent and the WOZ value is included in a general administrative order.

Om eventueel noodzakelijke aanpassingen eenvoudig te kunnen doorvoeren, wordt de cijfermatige uitwerking van de relatie tussen de waarde die in box 3 in aanmerking wordt genomen, de huurprijs en de WOZ-waarde in een algemene maatregel van bestuur opgenomen.
d: omitting eigenwoning-related application for efficiency reasons
ratio between box 3 eigenwoning value, rent and WOZ value
omitting certain rules for efficiency reasons
percentage for rented homes and erfpacht canon valuation
designating cases of ex officio reduction
lower valuation of on-site facilities in kind
rules for company cars for private use and related wage items
conditions and restrictions for excise goods place permit
detailed rules for excise refunds for horticulture and large consumers
conditions for consumption records moved to lower regulation
further rules on registration of non-resident persons
p: Wage-cost scheme lets employers designate allowances taxed as eindheffing, with the inspector only checking whether amounts are not substantially above usual levels.

Provisional assessments and ex officio reductions are made non-appealable as objections, with interest and related items folded into the assessment, narrowing taxpayer remedies at the objection stage.
The numerical relation between eigenwoning valuation, rent and WOZ value is set by general administrative order rather than in the statute.

parties: Asks the government to justify the 80% levy, the budgetary effects and the consultation with stakeholders before the reform.
The CDA members would like to know from the government when the form of this reform was discussed with relevant parties in the field, when they could provide input and what their views were.'

De leden van de CDA-fractie zouden graag van de regering vernemen wanneer de vorm van deze hervorming is overlegd met relevante partijen in het veld, wanneer zij hun input konden leveren en wat die mening was.
Asks the government to respond to criticism from employer organisations and the NOB on the wage-cost scheme.
Can the government respond to these comments?
Kan de regering een reactie geven op deze commentaren?
Supports simplification but proposes that the wage-cost scheme be handled in a separate bill after better consultation with employers and employees.
The government should choose to conduct better consultation with employer and employee organisations on this and then submit a separate bill to the States General as soon as possible.'

De regering zou ervoor moeten kiezen hierover beter overleg met organisaties van werkgevers en werknemers te voeren en vervolgens zo spoedig mogelijk een afzonderlijk wetsvoorstel aan de Staten-Generaal aan te bieden.
Suspects the wage-cost scheme is in effect a tax increase and questions the 1.5% threshold and the planned start date.
The PVV members wonder whether this goal will actually be achieved or whether this regulation is simply intended as a tax increase.'
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen zich af of dit doel daadwerkelijk behaald gaat worden en of deze regelgeving niet gewoon bedoeld is als belastingverhoging.
Asks about the distributional effects of the wage-cost scheme and the cost of the cheaper-housing and partner-definition changes for citizens.
Can a justification be given for the increase in burden from streamlining the partner concept?
Kan een onderbouwing worden gegeven van de lastenverzwaring van het stroomlijnen van het partnerbegrip?
Worries that the wage-cost scheme conflicts with environmental goals by removing bicycle and fitness schemes.
They fear that many employers will choose in this way, especially in sectors with relatively low wages, to abolish favourable company bicycle schemes, for example.'
Zij zijn bang dat veel werkgevers er op deze manier voor kiezen, zeker in sectoren met relatief lage lonen, om bijvoorbeeld gunstige bedrijfsfietsregelingen af te schaffen.
Asks what costs fall under the 1.5% cap and whether a counter-evidence rule would be useful.
Which cost items all fall under this cap, these members ask.'
Welke kostenposten vallen allemaal onder deze maximering, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks about administrative burdens, the effect on small firms and the proposed telephone revision of provisional assessments affecting taxpayers' remedies.
Can the government respond to the survey by VNO-NCW and MKB-NL, which shows that the wage-cost scheme actually imposes a burden increase of more than 1 billion per year?
Kan de regering reageren op de inventarisatie van VNO-NCW en MKB-NL, waaruit blijkt dat de werkkostenregeling juist een lastenverzwaring inhoudt van meer dan 1 miljard per jaar?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the Fiscal Simplification Act 2010 be revised in several respects, especially the temporary rental regime for the owner-occupied home, the werkkostenregeling and the wealth-yield tax. The government's nader rapport accepts several remarks, keeps the temporary-rental change with explanation, and largely rejects or clarifies the others.
concerns: The Raad doubts the enforceability of the temporary-rental regime for the owner-occupied home and advises reconsidering its inclusion; the government keeps it, citing budget neutrality and promising to review guidance material.
The Raad asks for a justification of the 80% tariff for the werkkostenregeling and for the budgetary basis of the 1.5% forfait; the explanation has been added to the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad flags tension with EU free movement for wages paid by foreign employers; the government adds a provision on personnel discounts but does not fully resolve the cross-border treatment.
The Raad asks for explanation of the wealth-yield tax's character after the single reference date and its relevance for tax treaties; the government explains the change in the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad suggests aligning the €500 cash exemption with the €2,800 small-debt threshold; the government rejects this, arguing the amounts serve different purposes.
The Raad gives a series of editorial and technical corrections in an annex; most are adopted, with one on the Wet schadeloosstelling leden Tweede Kamer not followed.

32211.s: The bill introduces a national registration requirement for sex workers and a uniform municipal permit system for sex businesses (prostitution businesses and escort agencies), with conditions on operators and advertising. It also sets up a national register of escort permits, allows officials to enter homes where prostitution is suspected without consent, and creates criminal penalties for unregistered work and use of unregistered sex workers.
32211.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the lack of insight into the sector and persistent abuses such as trafficking and minors, arguing that controls after the fact would be ineffective and that a national framework is needed.
q: The lack of insight into the sector and the absence of a framework tailored to this industry have allowed many highly undesirable abuses in this industry to persist.
Het ontbreken van zicht op de sector en het gebrek aan een op deze branche toegespitst kader hebben allerlei zeer ongewenste misstanden in deze branche laten voortbestaan.
d: rules on register, registration and registration certificate
municipal rules on public conduct of sex workers
municipal cap on number of permits and local rules on sex businesses
municipal rules on permit application procedure and documents
additional moral conduct requirements for operators and managers
municipal additional grounds for refusing or revoking permits
municipal power to ban prostitution businesses entirely
hygiene and health measures and business plan content
p: Officials may enter a dwelling without the occupant's consent where prostitution is or is reasonably suspected to take place, with a mayoral authorisation required under general administrative law.
Artikel 14 lid 1 sub g; Artikel 17 sub e; Artikel 18
Permits may be refused or revoked on broad grounds such as suspicion of trafficking or irregular residence and on vaguely defined bad moral conduct.
Artikel 15 lid 1 sub b; Artikel 18 lid 1 sub e
Integrity screening by a national bureau may be used to refuse or revoke permits, with the bureau's advice as the only safeguard.
The mayor may cancel a sex worker's registration in addition to the statutory grounds, giving broad administrative discretion over individuals' ability to work.
Criminal liability is attached to unregistered work and use of unregistered services, extending state sanctions to clients and workers.

parties: Asks whether the instruments are adequate to combat trafficking and whether the focus is on the victims versus the clients, and questions the age limit of 18.
However, remarks are made, among others by the Council of State, on whether the proposed instruments are sufficient for that purpose.
Er worden echter opmerkingen gemaakt, onder andere door de Raad van State, of het nu aangedragen instrumentarium daarvoor toereikend is.

Argues registration is a paper measure that does not identify victims of coerced prostitution and asks how the registration moment can be used to detect trafficking; questions privacy and registration weigering.
The PvdA members share the Council of State's view that on this point the bill threatens to become primarily a paper measure.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie delen de mening van de Raad van State dat op dit punt het wetsvoorstel vooral een papieren maatregel dreigt te worden.

Doubts that registration will combat abuses, fears negative side effects such as prostitutes disappearing underground, and questions compliance with the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens and the necessity test.
The Council of State concludes that the registration obligation cannot pass the necessity test and that the overriding public interest cannot be met either.
De Raad van State komt tot het oordeel dat de registratieplicht de noodzakelijkheidstoets niet kan doorstaan en dat evenmin kan worden voldaan aan het zwaarwegend algemeen belang.
Questions the assumption that registration protects against trafficking, warns that coerced people may register and that privacy and power imbalances with exploiters are harmed.
Does this not precisely strengthen the power imbalance between exploiters and prostitutes?
Versterkt dit niet juist de machtsongelijkheid tussen exploitanten en prostituees?
Suggests a more centralised registration with expert intake to detect coercion, and questions the absence of a victim-based refusal ground and the data protection argument.
In the view of these members, more centralised registration offers more scope to meet the explanatory memorandum's recommendation to involve experts in the registration interview.

Naar de mening van deze leden biedt een meer gecentraliseerde registratie meer mogelijkheden om te voldoen aan de aanbevelingen in de memorie van toelichting om deskundigen bij het registratiegesprek te betrekken.
Supports central regulation and mandatory registration as improving grip on the sector and enabling more effective action against abuses.
Together with mandatory registration of prostitutes, this will facilitate grip on and sight of the sector and thereby enable more effective action against abuses.
Samen met de verplichte registratie van prostituees zal dit de grip en het zicht op de branche vergemakkelijken en daardoor zal effectiever kunnen worden opgetreden tegen misstanden.
Asks whether the bill will sufficiently curb abuses without intensified enforcement, and whether municipalities should be obliged to report suspected exploitation to police.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion (11 September 2009) on the bill regulating prostitution and combating abuses in the sex industry criticises the objectives, the registration duty for prostitutes, the escort registry, the 'zero option' and European law justification, and advises reconsideration of several parts. The minister's nader rapport of 6 November 2009 largely rejects these objections, defending the registration duty, the national escort register and the zero option, while adapting definitions, delegation provisions and some drafting.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that the proposed measures, especially the registration duty, effectively combat abuses and that the stated objectives are achieved by them.

The registration duty for prostitutes does not appear to meet the necessity and proportionality tests under the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, which the government partly answered by supplementing the explanatory memorandum and limiting access to the register in the statute.

Registration of prostitutes is a processing of personal data that may be disproportionate to privacy interests, requiring a justification for a compelling general interest; the government rejected the classification as special personal data but added safeguards.

The justification under the Services Directive (public order, human dignity) for the registration duty and establishment requirement for foreign providers is insufficiently substantiated and must be proportionate.
Essential matters such as access to the register and its use should be set in the statute itself rather than delegated to an AMvB.
Definitions of prostitution, sex business, exploiter and client overlap or are unclear and should be revised for practical application.
Escort business licensing and enforcement depend on local authorities, which raises practical enforcement concerns; the government rejected a national licence but agreed on regional coordination.

The explanatory memorandum does not address the thuiswerkende prostituee and the consequences for voluntary registration, and does not align the zero option with the text; these points were added to the memorandum.

32220.s: The bill amends three statutes (for Tweede Kamer members, Eerste Kamer members and the pension law for political office holders) so that their allowances and pension entitlements are paid only to the person and cannot be assigned to third parties. It is designed to protect the independence of parliamentarians, and it uses the two-thirds majority required by Article 63 of the Constitution.
32220.j: The memorandum justifies the non-assignability rule by the need to guarantee the independence of members of parliament, in line with the constitutional requirement to vote without instruction, and notes the Council of State's advice to apply the two-thirds majority of Article 63.
q: So it is that We, having heard the Council of State and in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed as follows
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

parties: Asks whether there is a concrete reason for the bill, what the effect is on existing assignments followed by Parliament, and how implementation will work.
Is there a concrete reason to now provide, through this bill, a provision regulating that governments do not honour assignments?
Is er een concrete aanleiding om nu via dit wetsvoorstel te voorzien in een bepaling waarin wordt geregeld dat overheden cessies niet naleven?
Asks how party fee arrangements and the tax treatment of assigned income work, and how other European countries regulate the disposal of pay in relation to MPs' independence.
Can the government give insight into how freedom to dispose of the remuneration of political office holders is regulated in other European countries?
Kan de regering inzicht geven in de wijze waarop de vrijheid van de besteding van de bezoldiging van politieke ambtsdragers in andere Europese landen geregeld is?

Criticises the bill as unmotivated and aimed only at their party, arguing it may breach the free-mandate principle and the Constitution, and questions the government's approach of imposing a legal measure without consultation.
The SP members share the Council of State's view that the government gives no 'convincing justification' for this bill.
De leden van de SP-fractie delen de opvatting van de Raad van State dat de regering geen «overtuigende motivering» geeft voor dit wetsvoorstel.

Supports the bill to safeguard the independence of members and the oath, but asks about legal dilemmas, freedom of association, and whether party statutes requiring fee-payment declarations conflict with the oath.
In their view, using the deed of assignment is contrary to the purification oath.
Naar hun mening is het gebruik maken van de akte van cessie in strijd met de zuiveringseed.
Supports the aim of preventing direct payment relations between government and political parties, considering assignments that route pay to parties undesirable.
Assignment agreements under which pay and allowances are transferred to the party, which then gives the office holders a lower income, are according to the PVV members undesirable.

Cessieovereenkomsten waarbij bezoldigingen en vergoedingen worden overgedragen aan de partij en daarna deze partij de politieke ambtsdragers een lager inkomen verschaft, zijn volgens de leden van de PVV-fractie ongewenst.
Asks how enforcement of the assignment ban is supervised, whether the paying body must verify the account holder, and how the bill relates to party fee arrangements and political independence.
Must the paying body always verify that the account number the elected member provides is indeed under the control of the elected member?
Zal de uitbetalende instantie zich steeds ervan dienen te vergewissen, dat het rekeningnummer dat de gekozene opgeeft, inderdaad onder beheer van de gekozene staat?

Asks the government to clarify the principled difference between direct payment by the state to parties and mandatory fee arrangements between members and parties, in light of the constitutional ban on binding mandates.

Following the Council of State's advice, the SGP members ask whether the government can explain the principled difference between direct payment by the state to political parties and mandatory fee arrangements between representatives and parties.

Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad van State vragen de leden van de SGP-fractie of de regering nader toe kan lichten wat het principiële verschil is tussen de rechtstreekse betaling door de overheid aan politieke partijen en de verplichte afdrachtregelingen tussen volksvertegen-woordigers en partijen.
Party payment obligations in party statutes may conflict with the purification oath and MPs' independence from their party; asks how the bill addresses this and whether such statutes are valid.
In the view of the VVD fractie, in that situation there is a conflict with the purification oath.
Naar de mening van de leden van de VVD-fractie is er in die situatie sprake van strijd met de zuiveringseed.

Questions whether the bill is proportionate and justified given the freedom of association; argues voluntary party payment schemes should not be banned and the government has not given the reasons for the legislation.
However, these bills are a direct infringement of freedom of association, the SP fractie observes.
Deze wetsvoorstellen zijn echter een directe inbreuk op de vrijheid van vereniging, zo constateren de leden van de SP-fractie.
Asks how the bill relates to freedom of association under Article 8 of the Constitution and whether an employment-like relationship between MP and party could arise.
These members ask whether a de facto employment relationship could arise between office holder and party where a party-wide agreement exists on a (substantial) payment arrangement.
Deze leden vragen of er een de facto arbeidsrelatie kan ontstaan tussen ambtsdrager en partij in het geval dat een partijbrede overeenkomst bestaat over een (aanzienlijke) betalingsregeling.
Asks about the tax effects of cession agreements and whether they affect control and accountability by the MP and the party.
Does a cession agreement have consequences for control and accountability, both by the MP concerned and by the party concerned?
Heeft een cessieovereenkomst gevolgen voor controle en verantwoording, zowel door de betrokken volksvertegenwoordiger als door de betrokken politieke partij ?
Asks whether the cessie ban resolves conflicts with the purification oath and free mandate, and how party statutes requiring allowance payments affect MPs' independence.
Either the deed of assignment conflicts with the purification oath, in which case it is clear to them what must be done.'
Of wel de akte van cessie is in strijd met de zuiveringseed, dan is voor hen duidelijk wat er moet gebeuren.
Asks whether a mandatory payment arrangement conflicts with the purification oath and whether politicians can evade expense rules by routing allowances through party coffers.
Can political office holders evade the rules for claiming expenses by paying their allowance and expense reimbursement into the party coffers and claiming expenses from the party?
Kunnen politieke ambtsdragers de regels voor het declareren van onkosten ontwijken door hun ambtstoelage en onkostenvergoeding in de partijkas te storten en onkosten te declareren bij de partij?
Objects that the government intervenes in the internal democracy of parties and in voluntary payment arrangements, and questions the legal reasoning behind the ban.
Why does the government feel called upon to intervene in the internal democracy of a political party?
Waarom voelt de regering zich geroepen in te grijpen in de interne democratie van een politieke partij?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises reconsidering the draft bill banning assignment of parliamentary remuneration to third parties, questioning its necessity, scope, need for two-thirds majority under Article 63 of the Constitution, and immediate entry into force. The government replies it will apply the two-thirds majority requirement, extends the entry-into-force period to six months, but rejects narrowing the ban to party-affiliated bodies and rejects the advice on entry into force at the next election.
concerns: The Raad questions the necessity of a statutory ban and whether the goal could be achieved through good consultation without legislation; the government rejects this, arguing uniformity requires a legal rule.
The Raad argues Article 63 of the Constitution applies and a two-thirds majority is required; the government adopts this approach and amends the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad advises limiting the assignment ban to political parties and affiliated bodies; the government declines, citing difficulty defining affiliated bodies.
The Raad advises delaying entry into force until the first sitting after the next elections; the government rejects this but lengthens the period to six months.
The Raad suggests a redactional amendment to the preamble of Article V, which is adopted.

32310.s: The bill transfers the decision-making and execution of benefits under the Dutch resistance and war-victim laws from the Pensioen- en Uitkeringsraad (PUR) largely to the Sociale verzekeringsbank (SVB), while the PUR keeps a role as adviser and sets policy rules. It also makes the Minister of VWS responsible for supervising the SVB in this task, with the Kaderwet zbo applied and the PUR statute repealed.
32310.j: The memorandum justifies the transfer by arguing that the minister is politically accountable and needs a direct accountability line to the SVB, and that the PUR's expertise and ties to beneficiaries are preserved through its advisory and policy-setting role.
q: For this reason the third paragraph expressly provides that, deviating from Article 36(2) of the SUWI Act, the Minister of VWS is competent to supervise the SVB's implementation of the resistance and war-victim laws.

Om deze reden is in het derde lid expliciet bepaald dat in afwijking van artikel 36, tweede lid, van de Wet SUWI de minister van VWS bevoegd is toezicht uit te oefenen op de uitvoering door de SVB van de wetten voor verzetsdeelnemers en oorlogsgetroffenen.
d: PUR sets policy rules for SVB decisions
PUR sets rules on performing its tasks
rules on costs of implementing the act
rules on use of transferred assets
p: Supervision of the SVB's implementation is placed with the minister instead of the Inspectie Werk en Inkomen, displacing the default supervisory body.
The criminal sanction for failing to provide information under the SUWI Act is made inapplicable to this implementation.
Kaderwet zbo powers to demand information and annul SVB decisions are applied to the minister for this task, with the minister's annulment power limited to conflict with law or the general interest.
SVB may depart from PUR advice with a stated reason, though advice remains the starting point and deviations are reported.
Pending applications and public-law rights of the PUR transfer to the SVB, changing the decision-making body for existing claimants.

32395-F.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds), raising expenditure and receipts under article 1 for animal disease control, following the spring budget memorandum. It takes effect on 1 June of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.

32400.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act 1968 on mainly technical points to implement Council Directive 2009/162/EU, extending the gas/heat/cooling/electricity rules to new network definitions and changing VAT deduction rules for real estate used partly privately. It takes effect on 1 January 2011 and preserves prior deduction rights for pre-existing cases.
32400.j: The memorandum justifies the correction mechanism by pointing to the existing delegation in article 15(6) and the existing investment-goods revision regime, and says it simplifies filing and reduces audits.
q: The fact that private use no longer has to be taxed separately and additionally leads to a simplification of the filing process.
Het feit dat het privégebruik niet meer apart en aanvullend hoeft te worden belast, leidt tot een vereenvoudiging van het aangifteproces.
d: proportional deduction for mixed-use real estate, via correction mechanism based on article 15(6) delegation

parties: Asks technical questions on implementation timing, transitional rules, administrative burden and budgetary effects, without raising checks on the executive.
However, the members of the VVD group have a number of questions and refer, among other things, to the comments of the Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs of 2 September 2010.
De leden van de fractie van de VVD hebben echter een aantal vragen en verwijzen hierbij onder andere naar het commentaar van de Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs van 2 september 2010.
Asks about budgetary calculations of the one-off revenue effect and the reaction to administrative burden comments.
The members of the PvdA group ask the government to respond to the comments of the Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs on this bill, in particular the remarks on administrative burden.

De leden van de fractie van de PvdA vragen de regering een reactie te geven op het commentaar van de Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs op het onderhavige wetsvoorstel, met name op de opmerkingen over de administratieve lasten.
Asks why certain options were not chosen, possible objections, budgetary effects of the gas and electricity exemption, and whether the directive contributes to preventing VAT fraud.
More generally, the members of the SP group wonder whether the Technical Revision Directive still makes any contribution to preventing VAT fraud.
Meer in zijn algemeenheid vragen de leden van de SP-fractie zich af of de Technische Herzieningsrichtlijn nog enige bijdrage levert aan het voorkomen van BTW-fraude.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft bill implementing the 2009 VAT Technical Amendment Directive, which changes VAT deduction and private-use correction for immovable property, raising points on deduction wording, terminology and scope. The minister's reply followed most advice (deduction wording, terminology, scope explanation, Article 5b) but rejected the advice to align the private-use correction in Article 16 Wet OB 1968 and kept some redactional points unchanged.
concerns: Article 15(1) should be amended so the omitted reference to the directive principles (Articles 167, 168, 169, 173) does not create unclarity in the deduction rule.

The Raad advised adding a ranking rule so that Article 16(1) Wet OB and the BUA private-use correction are aligned with the new deduction rule; the government declined, arguing the BUA only applies where deduction exists under Article 15.
Terminology in Article 15(6) on revision of deduction should be aligned with the new paragraph's wording ('belaste handelingen').
Article 39 second sentence of the directive should be implemented as Article 5b(3) Wet OB, which the government did.
The explanatory memorandum should justify why the immovable-property scheme is not extended to comparable movable assets, which the government supplemented.

Several redactional remarks on placement of the second sentence, cross-references, the transposition table and examples were proposed; the government kept the placement in Article 15(1) and followed the other points.

32565-G.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds (VAT compensation fund), reducing expenditure by 21,500 thousand euros and raising receipts by the same amount through a supplementary budget linked to the Najaarsnota. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 1 December 2010, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the 2010 budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds (amendment linked to the Najaarsnota)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatiefonds voor het jaar 2010 (wijziging samenhangende met de Najaarsnota)

32780-H.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) by increasing its expenditure by 3,603 thousand euros, in line with the Voorjaarsnota. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Amendment of the 2011 budget statement of the BES-fonds (H) (amendment linked to the Spring Memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H) voor het jaar 2011 (wijziging samenhangend met de Voorjaarsnota)

33003.s: This bill, the Belastingplan 2012 package, cuts income tax rates and brackets, adjusts the zelfstandigenaftrek and FOR, reshapes levensloopregeling into vitaliteitssparen with new delegated rules, lowers the afdrachtvermindering onderwijs thresholds and extends it to foreign training, and introduces an objectvrijstelling for foreign business profits in the Vpb. It also sets horizon clauses for several tax expenditures and delegates detailed rules to ministerial regulation and AMvB, while abolishing certain excise regimes.
33003.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the technical nature of the rules and the need for detailed implementation, such as the requirement that the rules for vitaliteitssparen providers be set by general administrative order.
q: General administrative regulations will set rules on the designation referred to in the second paragraph, part d.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot de in het tweede lid, onderdeel d, bedoelde aanwijzing.
d: rules on foreign education certificates by Minister OCW
Artikel XXII, G (art. 79 Wet op de accijns)
return and destruction of excise stamps
p: Allows general administrative measures to set rules on the objectvrijstelling and foreign profit offset, shifting detail from statute to the executive.

parties: Supports simplification and the abolition of small taxes but asks for clarification on several components of the plan.

The government's intention to arrive at a simpler, more solid and more fraud-resistant tax system, with the main goal of financing government spending back at the forefront, can count on the support of the VVD faction.

Het voornemen van de regering om te komen tot een eenvoudiger, meer solide en fraudebestendiger belastingstelsel waarbij het hoofddoel – het financieren van overheidsuitgaven – weer voorop moet komen te staan, kan op steun van de leden van de VVD-fractie rekenen.

Criticises the speed of the fiscal agenda without parliamentary debate, the chosen priorities, and the revenue gap from abolishing environmental taxes, and questions whether the abolished taxes can be reversed.
The government has already begun implementing the Fiscal Agenda without debating it with the House of Representatives, and the introduction of the Geefwet is under great time pressure.
Zo heeft de regering de uitvoering van de Fiscale agenda al ter hand genomen zonder dat hierover is gedebatteerd met de Tweede Kamer en staat de invoering van de Geefwet onder grote tijdsdruk.
Endorses simplification, abolition of small taxes and the stronger solidity measures, while lamenting that the simplification goals are not sufficiently realised.
The PVV faction wholeheartedly agrees with the idea of a 'simpler, more solid and more fraud-resistant tax system'.
De leden van de PVV-fractie stemmen van harte in met de idee van «een eenvoudiger, meer solide en fraudebestendig belastingstelsel».

Supports simplification and anti-fraud aims but asks detailed questions on the waste tax abolition, asbestos disposal, the Eurovignet and the anti-abuse interest deduction rule, including whether taxpayers can rebut the rule.
Is the government willing to create a rebuttal possibility for such cases and other cases where there is in fact no excessive financing?
Is de regering bereid om voor dit soort gevallen en voor andere gevallen waarin feitelijk geen sprake is van excessieve financiering een tegenbewijsmogelijkheid te creëren?
Expresses disapproval of abolishing the waste tax and questions the rationale, revenue figures and effects of several abolitions and the interest deduction rule.
The SP faction has noted with disapproval the proposal to abolish the waste tax.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met afkeuring kennisgenomen van het voorstel om de afvalstoffenbelasting af te schaffen.
Supports the goals and the overnameholding interest measure but asks technical and proportionality questions about its design and the cooperative dividend tax rule.
The D66 faction asks whether the government, with these measures, actually addresses the core of the problem.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen of de regering met deze maatregelen de kern van de problematiek daadwerkelijk aanpakt.
Criticises the abolition of environmental taxes as a greening loss and asks why the government does not pursue greening alternatives.
The GroenLinks faction is disappointed that the government chooses to de-green taxes.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks zijn teleurgesteld dat de regering kiest voor de ontgroening van de belastingen.
Poses many questions on the rationale for abolitions, budget priorities, revenue loss and consistency with EU water and environmental obligations.
What has more priority for the cabinet, financing government spending and reducing the budget deficit, or simplification and thus abolishing a number of taxes, the ChristenUnie faction asks.

Wat heeft voor het kabinet meer prioriteit, het financieren van overheidsuitgaven en het terugdringen van het overheidstekort, of vereenvoudiging en dus afschaffen van een aantal belastingen, zo vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie.
Has questions for the government in the report without stating a substantive position in the excerpt.
These members wish to put a number of questions to the government in this report.
Deze leden willen de regering in dit verslag nog een aantal vragen voorhouden.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory opinion on the nota van wijziging to the Belastingplan 2012 raises objections on the effectiveness of the research and development deduction (RDA), the statutory basis for the grondslag and deduction percentage (delegation to a general administrative order), the meaning of direct attributable costs, EU state aid aspects, the missing sunset clause and evaluation goals, and budget mechanics. The government's nader rapport largely accepts these points: it adds effectiveness justification, clarifies the direct costs wording, notes no state aid since the measure is generic, and explains why it declined a five-year sunset clause while committing to evaluation after five years.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a fuller explanation of the expected effectiveness of the RDA and why a generic fiscal subsidy is preferable to a specific subsidy, which the government addressed by adding justification to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling holds that the grondslag and RDA percentage are essentials of taxation that belong in the statute rather than in an algemene maatregel van bestuur, and the government kept them in lower regulation while strengthening some legal protection in the statute.

The Afdeling asks for clarification of what counts as direct attributable costs, including mixed-use buildings, and the government clarified that subcontracted R&D in principle does not qualify and deferred the rest to lower regulation.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address EU state aid aspects, and the government added that the generic measure involves no state aid.

The Afdeling recommends a five-year sunset clause and a more concrete, testable goal for evaluation, and the government declined the sunset clause for investor certainty but committed to evaluation after five years and explained the measurable R&D indicators.

The Afdeling notes the budget carry-over mechanism fails if the RDA is terminated, and the government explained that unused budget is freed in the year of termination and any remaining surplus or deficit is handled within the existing spending framework.
The Afdeling flags possible overlap between the RDA and the KIA, EIA and MIA deductions, and the government will address overlap in lower regulation if needed.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the Belastingplan 2012 but raises general points and specific objections on abolishing small taxes, the corporate tax interest-deduction limits and object exemption for permanent establishments, the vitality package and the temporary cut in transfer tax, advising amendments. The government's nader rapport responds point by point, accepting some adjustments (e.g. wording, vitaliteitssparen limits, added motivation) while defending the bundling, the cross-subsidy design, and the tax measures against the Raad's objections.
concerns: Advice to use a separate bill for the RDA and to avoid notes of amendment is not followed; the government submits the RDA via a nota van wijziging.
Doubts about the budgetary justification for abolishing seven small taxes; the government adds clarification but maintains full budgetary coverage.
Advice to split the corporate tax measures on overnameholdings and permanent establishments into a separate bill is rejected; the government argues budgetary linkage justifies bundling.
Objection that the interest-deduction limit lacks a rebuttal (tegenbewijs) clause is rejected by the government on grounds of simplicity and budget.

Concerns about lack of quantified objectives, expected effectiveness and budgetary risk of the werkbonus and flexsparen; government adds justification and an evaluation horizon but no quantified estimate.
Doubt about the justification for the temporary transfer tax cut; government supplements the motivation in the explanatory memorandum.

33021.s: The bill implements Directive 2010/78/EU on the powers of the three new European supervisory authorities (EBA, EIOPA, ESMA) and the European Systemic Risk Board, mainly by adding a new Wft section on cooperation and information exchange with EU bodies. It also makes consequential amendments to the Wft, Faillissementswet, Pensioenwet and Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling, redirecting notifications from the European Commission to the new EU authorities.
33021.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as a technical means to implement the detailed cooperation and information-exchange obligations of the Directive.
q: This is intended to allow a technical implementation of this cooperation.
Dit is bedoeld om een technische uitvoering te kunnen geven aan deze samenwerking.
d: detailed rules on cooperation, dispute settlement and data transfer within the European System of Financial Supervision
p: Allows the minister to set detailed rules by ministerial regulation for cooperation and information exchange with EU authorities, without explicit parliamentary involvement.

parties: Asks how the ESRB's non-binding recommendations will be followed by member states, on what criteria recommendations are published, and how ESRB data access relates to firms' privacy.
How does the European Commission ensure that the ESRB's advice and recommendations, despite their non-binding nature, are followed by member states?
Hoe zorgt de Europese Commissie ervoor dat de adviezen en aanbevelingen van ESRB, ondanks hun niet-bindende karakter, worden opgevolgd door de lidstaten?
Questions the effectiveness and decisiveness of the large ESRB board, whether comply-or-explain gives enough force, and how binding ESA interventions against member states will work.
These members ask whether the 'comply or explain' principle is sufficient. Does the ESRB have enough striking power with it?
Deze leden vragen of het «comply or explain» principe voldoende is. Heeft de ESRB hiermee voldoende slagkracht?
Asks whether the European supervisors have sufficient powers, how emergency measures and binding powers are triggered and enforced, and what information may be shared despite secrecy rules.
The CDA members ask the government to indicate to what extent the European supervisory authorities have really been given sufficient powers/teeth through this bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven in hoeverre de Europese toezichtautoriteiten met behulp van dit wetsvoorstel echt voldoende bevoegdheden/tanden hebben gekregen.
Asks about the direct effect of EU supervisory decisions on firms without national implementation, and requests an overview of the cases where supervisors can be called in to mediate in disputes.
The specific cases in which a national supervisor can, in a conflict with a supervisor of another member state, invoke mediation by a European supervisor are regulated in the Omnibus I directive.

De concrete gevallen waarin een nationale toezichthouder bij een conflict met een toezichthouder van een andere lidstaat een beroep kan doen op bemiddeling door een Europese toezichthouder is geregeld in de Omnibus I-richtlijn.

33102.s: The bill repeals the Invoeringswet Wet stedelijke vernieuwing and makes several redactional and technical amendments to housing-related laws, including the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte, the Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht and the Woningwet. It preserves the legal basis for existing ministerial regulations on housing-linked subsidies by transferring them to an algemene maatregel van bestuur under a new article 87 of the Woningwet.
33102.j: The memorandum justifies keeping existing ministerial regulations in force by transferring their legal basis, because repeal of the Invoeringswet would otherwise remove that basis.
q: That decree, and with it that legal basis, lapses with the repeal of the Invoeringswet Wet stedelijke vernieuwing.
Dat besluit, en daarmee die grondslag vervalt immers met de intrekking van de Invoeringswet Wet stedelijke vernieuwing.
d: Artikel I, lid 2 / Artikel V, onderdeel I (Woningwet art. 87)
housing-related financial support rules previously in ministerial regulations
prescriptions for financial support for housing purposes

33300.s: The bill transfers management of the public register of external safety data (risk register for pipelines and hazardous installations) from the RIVM to another institution to be designated by the minister, and makes related technical amendments to the Environmental Management Act and the Safety Regions Act following a departmental reorganisation. It also updates ministerial references and removes obsolete sentences.
33300.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a consequence of assigning the risk register to a different institution and of the departmental reorganisation, without giving a substantive rationale for new powers.
q: An institution to be designated by Our Minister.
Een door Onze Minister aan te wijzen instantie.
d: ARTIKEL I, D.1 (artikel 12.12, derde lid Wet milieubeheer)
designation of institution managing the external safety risk register

parties: Asks who is ultimately responsible for completeness and accuracy of supplied data once the minister designates the register manager, and where the designated body is recorded.
who is ultimately responsible for the completeness and accuracy of the data supplied, now that this task officially falls to the minister of Infrastructure and Environment
wie eindverantwoordelijk is voor de volledigheid en juistheid van de aangeleverde gegevens, nu officieel deze taak bij de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu komt te liggen
Asks whether the IPO will receive the financial means needed to manage the register and how any shortfall would be solved.
The IPO has however indicated that it cannot carry out the management if it does not have the necessary financial means.
Het IPO heeft echter aangegeven dat beheer niet te kunnen uitvoeren, als zij daartoe niet de benodigde financiële middelen heeft.
Asks why register management moved away from RIVM and how risk information will be shared with RIVM and coordinated among bodies.

Does the government share the view that risk assessment and registration require specialist knowledge and that too much shifting of management tasks between bodies could frustrate efficient deployment of those specialists?

Deelt de regering de mening dat risicobeoordeling en -registratie vraagt om specialistische kennis en dat te veel geschuif van de beheerstaken tussen instanties een efficiënte inzet van die specialisten kan frustreren?

Asks what the limited responsibility of the designated register manager means in practice and where responsibility for the integrated register product lies; also asks how competent authority for unregulated pipelines will be assigned.
Where does responsibility for the integrated overall product of the register lie?
Waar ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het integrale totaalproduct van het register?

33750-J.s: This bill establishes the 2014 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, setting expenditure and revenue at about EUR 1.231 billion across flood safety, freshwater supply, maintenance and experimentation articles. It also sets the budget's units (thousands of euros) and entry-into-force rules, and includes a budget experiment article under the Deltawet allowing spending on other policy areas with additional funding.
33750-J.j: The memorandum justifies the experiment article as enabling integrated implementation of the Deltaprogramma and integrated financing, and notes that budget shifts within the IenM budget will adjust spending to project planning.
q: The experiment article serves integrated implementation of the Delta Programme and allows integrated financing.
Het experimenteerartikel staat ten dienste van een integrale uitvoering van het Deltaprogramma en biedt de mogelijkheid tot integrale bekostiging.
d: experimental spending on other policy areas from the Deltafonds
p: The experiment article lets the executive spend Deltafonds money on nature, environment and economic development when linked to water measures and co-financed by other parties, with budget shifts handled administratively within the IenM budget.

33805-I.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statement of the Crown (Koning) by supplementary budget amounts, mainly reallocating funds across the Crown's articles and charging higher Kabinet van de Koning costs through to the Crown's budget. It takes effect from 1 December 2013, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: This concerns the charging to the Crown's budget of the higher expenditure at the Kabinet van de Koning.
Dit betreft de doorbelasting naar de begroting van de Koning van de hogere uitgaven bij het Kabinet van de Koning.

33930-J.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) amends the 2013 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, reflecting technical, bookkeeping and audit-driven budget adjustments and fixing the final 2013 figures. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

33940-I.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statement of the Royal Household (Koning I) by increasing expenditure commitments and expenditures by EUR 90 thousand, mainly for functional expenditures and charged expenditures from other budgets, with receipts rising by EUR 196 thousand. It is a supplementary budget adjustment that sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 June 2014.
q: Amendment of the budget statement attached to the budget of the Royal Household (I) for the year 2014 (First supplementary budget)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat behorende bij de begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2014 (Eerste suppletoire begroting)

33940-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statements for the ministry of Housing and Civil Service (XVIII) and for its executive agencies by making a first supplementary budget adjustment in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 June 2014, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that a need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of Housing and Civil Service (XVIII) and the budget statement for the agencies for the year 2014.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst (XVIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen alle voor het jaar 2014.

34002.s: The bill sets tax measures for 2015 and later: it adjusts income tax brackets, the leidingwater and waste/energy environmental taxes, the werkkostenregeling, the net annuity and net pension exemptions, and tax enforcement rules including versnelde invordering for benefit reclaims. It also contains a few delegations to ministerial regulation, such as rules for taxation of cars and benefit-related recovery procedures.
34002.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers mainly by fraud prevention, administrative efficiency and the Belastingdienst's enforcement needs.
q: The Tax Administration therefore checks whether a bank account provided by the citizen for paying out a tax refund or benefit is in his name.
De Belastingdienst controleert daarom of een door de burger opgegeven bankrekening voor de uitbetaling van een teruggaaf inkomstenbelasting of een toeslag, op zijn naam staat.
d: depreciation tables and taxation of used cars
p: Banks must provide account holder data to the tax authority and may use citizens' citizen service numbers internally for verification.
Artikel XIX, A-B (art. 31a Awir / versnelde invordering)
Benefit recovery authorities may collect reclaimed childcare benefit amounts immediately rather than waiting for the normal payment and summons procedure, in specified situations.
Tax authorities may suspend deadlines for dividend tax refunds while requesting information and may impose fines on third parties under extended time periods.

parties: Welcomes the labour-tax relief and housing measures and sees them as supporting recovery.
The VVD members have taken note with interest of the Tax Plan 2015.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het Belastingplan 2015.
Supports lower labour taxes but asks for a response to criticism that the DGA reversal of the burden of proof is improper.
The PvdA members also ask the government in its reply to address the comments of the Dutch Order of Tax Advisers.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie verzoeken de regering in haar beantwoording eveneens in te gaan op het commentaar van de Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs.
Asks whether the DGA rules let wealthy shareholders shift income into box 2 and pay lower tax, and whether the burden-of-proof shift is fair.
The SP members ask the government whether the transitional arrangement wrongly assumes everyone uses the efficiency margin.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of er bij de overgangsregeling niet ten onrechte vanuit wordt gegaan dat iedereen de doelmatigheidsmarge gebruikt?
Criticises the lack of tax reform, unworkable implementation, and asks whether the government will publish the implementation tests and year-end decree.
Is the government willing to send the Chamber all the (old) implementation tests applied to the measures in the Tax Plan?
Is de regering bereid om alle («oude») uitvoeringstoetsen, die op de maatregelen in het Belastingplan zijn losgelaten, aan de Kamer te doen toekomen?
Argues the DGA reform shifts the burden of proof onto taxpayers, worsening their legal position, and wants it postponed.
In the view of the PVV members, that burden of proof is covertly reversed.
In de optiek van de leden van de fractie van de PVV wordt die bewijslast stiekem omgedraaid.
Supports a broad tax reform and simplification and asks how the new DGA benchmark will operate.
Last year the Council of State also drew attention to a necessary restructuring of income tax in its advice on the Tax Plan 2014.
Vorig jaar vroeg de Raad van State in haar advies over het Belastingplan 2014 ook al aandacht voor een noodzakelijke herstructurering van de inkomstenbelasting.
Asks about the timing of measures in the later Fiscal Omnibus Act and the effect on the single-earner household.
The ChristenUnie members draw attention to the position of single-earner households with children.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen in het bijzonder aandacht voor de positie van alleenverdieners met kinderen.
Asks whether the simplification measures reduce long-term costs and the marginal tax burden.
They hope a major step can be made in revising the tax system.
Zij hopen dat er een grote slag gemaakt kan worden bij de herziening van het fiscale stelsel.
Asks how the government will take further steps toward simplification and an integrated tax reform.
What options does the government see for taking further steps toward simplifying the tax system within a foreseeable period (still within this cabinet term)?
Welke mogelijkheden ziet de regering, om binnen afzienbare termijn (nog binnen deze kabinetsperiode) tóch nog verdere stappen te zetten naar vereenvoudiging van het belastingstelsel?
Sees the tax relief and simplification as positive but only as an interim step, and asks about costs of the DGA changes.
This member considers the reduction of labour taxes and simplification of the tax system positive in Tax Plan 2015.
Dit lid is van mening dat de lastenverlichting op arbeid en een vereenvoudiging van het belastingstelsel positief is in het Belastingplan 2015.
Asks how the government could measure the complexity of the tax system in figures.
What options does the government see for expressing the complexity of the tax system in figures and/or indicators, asks member Van Vliet?
Welke mogelijkheden ziet de regering om de complexiteit van het belastingstelsel op enigerlei wijze uit te drukken in cijfers en/of kengetallen, vraagt het lid Van Vliet?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the Belastingplan 2015 bill but raises remarks on the restructuring of income tax, the bundling of non-budgetary measures in the tax plan, the werkkostenregeling, the gebruikelijkloonregeling, the local renewable energy regime and interest on collection, advising adaptation. The government's nader rapport responds to each point, adopting several changes (clarifying the loonbegrip, supplementing the memorie van toelichting, setting a six-week claim deadline for interest) while defending the bundling and the 25% margin and deferring the broader tax reform to a separate letter.
concerns: The Afdeling argues that a broader reform of income tax (base broadening and lower rates) is needed and the bill contains no announcement of it; the government responds that a broader reflection on the tax and benefits system will be sent on Prinsjesdag.

The Afdeling objects that non-budgetary measures do not belong in a Belastingplan and should be split into a separate Overige fiscale maatregelen bill; the government keeps them in the plan, arguing the bundling does not change its coherence.

The Afdeling finds the choice to tax private benefits under the werkkostenregeling's necessity criterion insufficiently justified on principle; the government supplemented the memorie van toelichting on this point.
