The Afdeling asks for clarity on whether the loonbegrip under the werkkostenregeling changed compared with the old regime; the government clarifies it has not changed in principle and explains the statutory wording.

The Afdeling questions the justification for raising the gebruikelijk loon and notes the 30% to 25% reduction of the doelmatigheidsmarge does not improve implementation; the government adds explanation and points to the IBO on zzp'ers, while accepting the budgetary rationale.
The Afdeling notes the lower margin will not improve enforcement because existing agreements must be replaced; the government acknowledges this and cites limited one-off costs of 1.3 million euro.

The Afdeling argues the 20% ownership cap for businesses in local renewable energy cooperatives is not directly linked to the small-scale local character sought; the government explains it as a non-arbitrary participation limit and supplements the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling asks whether the interest compensation following the Mariana Irimie judgment covers pre-2015 cases and clarifies the temporal scope; the government extends compensation to earlier cases on request within six weeks and supplements the explanation.

34011.s: The bill inserts new articles 106a to 106e into the Bankruptcy Act allowing courts to impose a civil-law director ban on directors of bankrupt legal entities in cases such as repeated bankruptcies, fraud-related liability findings, or fiscal penalties. It lets the curator and the public prosecutor request such bans, with court-appointed temporary directors, registration in the Trade Register, and a five-year maximum duration.
34011.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as needed to combat bankruptcy fraud, and notes that court discretion and a closed list of grounds serve as safeguards for bona fide directors.
q: In addition, the public prosecutor is given an independent power to request a civil-law director ban.
Daarnaast krijgt het openbaar ministerie de zelfstandige bevoegdheid om een civielrechtelijk bestuursverbod te vorderen.
p: Gives the curator and the public prosecutor, rather than only the courts, a standing power to request director bans on a limited list of grounds, with final decision left to the court.
Allows suspension of directors and appointment of temporary directors during proceedings on request of the prosecutor or curator, subject to court decision.

parties: Asks whether appeal and cassation should be available against a court-imposed management ban given its severity, and questions the discretion to pursue a civil ban without criminal prosecution.
Given the seriousness of the measure, these members consider it desirable that both appeal and cassation be open against the measure.
Gezien de ernst van de maatregel achten deze leden het wenselijk dat tegen de maatregel zowel beroep als cassatie openstaat.
Asks how informal (de facto) directors and foreign legal persons can be identified and reached by a ban, and how the enforcement works in practice.

Questions whether enforcement by a fine alone is sufficient, whether criminal sanctions for repeated violations are possible, and warns against settlements that let failing directors escape prosecution or a ban.
These members find it highly undesirable if a failing director could in this way escape criminal prosecution and/or a civil management ban.
Voornoemde leden vinden het uiterst onwenselijk als een falende bestuurder op deze manier toch zal kunnen ontkomen aan strafvervolging en/of een civielrechtelijk bestuursverbod.

Questions the role conflict between the curator and the Public Prosecution Service, the risk that a prosecutor overrides a curator's decision, and whether the prosecution service has the capacity and budget to carry out the new tasks.
Is the position and decision-making authority of the curator not undermined by the Public Prosecution Service?
Wordt de positie en beslissingsbevoegdheid van de curator dan niet ondermijnd door het OM?
Supports the bill as a preventive complement to existing remedies against bankruptcy fraud and asks about EU-level registration and cross-border cooperation.
The civil management ban, by contrast, has a preventive effect and can therefore be a valuable addition to the existing instruments.
Het civielrechtelijk bestuursverbod daarentegen heeft een preventieve werking en kan dus een waardevolle aanvulling zijn op het bestaande instrumentarium.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet civielrechtelijk bestuursverbod (civil-law director ban in the Faillissementswet), raising points on the purpose framing, the expanded role of the curator and conflicting creditor interests, lack of judicial criteria, a director-ban for dominant shareholders under property rights, and privacy and public register issues. The government's reply accepted most points, clarifying the explanatory memorandum, adding judicial criteria, adjusting the bill to require final judgments and linking the grounds to the bankruptcy at issue, while defending the curator role, the register and the shareholder provision with added justification.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for criteria guiding the judge on when a director ban is justified; the government added illustrative factors to the explanatory memorandum.
The grounds for a director ban were to be linked to the bankruptcy concerned and to require final (onherroepelijke) judgments; the bill was amended accordingly.
Ban on a dominant shareholder interferes with property rights under Article 1 of Protocol 1 ECHR; the government added a fair-balance justification and explanation.

Public register of director bans interferes with privacy (Art. 10 Grondwet, Art. 8 ECHR); government justified the register but the Afdeling's request for a formal-law basis and purpose limitation was addressed only partly.

Expanding the curator's task to seek director bans conflicts with creditors' interests and is a substantial broadening of the curator's role; the government defended the expansion, citing supervision by the rechter-commissaris.
Discrepancy between the stated purpose (fraud combating) and the broader wording of the bill; the explanatory memorandum was clarified.
Grounds in article 106a(1)(a), (d) and (e) were to be related to the bankruptcy of the relevant legal person; the text was adjusted.

34085-H.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statement of the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and commitments by small amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the amendment to take effect from 1 December 2014, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the BES-fonds (H) for the year 2014.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H), voor het jaar 2014.

34200-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the States General (IIA) by adjusting appropriations across the policy articles, and sets the amount unit at thousands of euros and retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year. It is a budgetary closing law (Slotwet) that records realised figures against the budget.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2014
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2014

34775-B.s: This bill sets the 2018 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at 28,281,870 thousand euros and fixes the commitment amounts for the general grant, integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It also sets the entry-into-force rule of 1 January 2018, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears late.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2018 at € 16,400,415,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2018 vastgesteld op € 16.400.415.000.

35000-IIB.s: This bill sets the 2019 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, the Governors' cabinets and the Kiesraad, in thousands of euros, and takes effect on 1 January 2019. It is a budget appropriation law with no delegation of rule-making power or shift of power to the executive.
q: Article 1 The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2019 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35010.s: The bill reduces the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget) for couples by applying a 6.75% phase-out above a raised income threshold of €16,500, and removes the related article 6. It also freezes the €16,500 amount from 1 January 2020 and repeals the fixing provisions from 1 January 2021.
35010.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by noting that policy reasons may require raising the amounts, which would be done by general administrative order.
q: Adjusting this amount for policy reasons is possible by general administrative order.
Aanpassing van dit bedrag om beleidsmatige redenen is mogelijk bij algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: Artikel I, B, 1 (article 3, second paragraph, and the indexation power)
raising the threshold amounts for reasons of policy via general administrative order
p: Allows the government to change the €16,500 threshold for policy reasons by general administrative order, without a statutory amendment.

parties: Asks about the administrative burden and how eligible couples will be informed and whether automatic granting, as the Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk suggested, was considered.
Why was this approach not chosen in the proposal?
Waarom is er in het voorstel niet voor deze werkwijze gekozen?
Positive about the bill but asks whether it is fraud-resistant given the system's complexity and recent benefit fraud, and asks about simplification.

Given the complexity of the kindgebonden budget system and recent unemployment benefit fraud, the CDA would like to know how fraud-resistant the Wet op het kindgebonden budget is after this amendment.

In het licht van de complexiteit van het systeem van kindgebonden budget en de recente fraude met werkloosheidsuitkeringen zouden de leden van de CDA-fractie graag van de regering vernemen hoe fraudebestendig de Wet op het kindgebonden budget na voorliggende wetswijziging is.
Asks whether labour-market effects, such as reduced part-time work for the lower-earning partner, were considered.
The D66 members ask whether the possible labour-market effects of this measure have also been taken into account.although
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of ook rekening gehouden is met de eventuele arbeidsmarkteffecten van deze maatregel.
Welcomes the bill as a good step for working parents on middle incomes and asks about Caribbean Netherlands and whether the personal letter is a one-off action.
They see this as a good step in supporting working parents on middle incomes.
Zij zien dit als een goede stap in het ondersteunen van werkende ouders met een middeninkomen.
Questions why the threshold is set at about €75,000 rather than lower and asks for costed alternatives and the distribution of benefits.

Raises the consequences of linking child benefit to the kindgebonden budget for single parents and students, asks for safeguards, and asks whether payment could be made afterwards rather than in advance.
They ask why the regulations contain no safeguards to prevent this domino effect.
Zij vragen waarom in de regelgeving geen waarborgen opgenomen worden om dit domino-effect te voorkomen.

35100.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act to implement Article 83bis of the Chicago Convention, allowing the state of registration of an aircraft to transfer oversight of airworthiness and crew competence to the state of operation through a bilateral agreement. It adds definitions, adjusts the scope of the Act for Dutch and foreign-registered aircraft under such agreements, and introduces a new article 7.7 setting conditions for concluding such agreements.
35100.j: The memorandum justifies the transfer of oversight as a practical response to leasing arrangements that complicate supervision of airworthiness and flight operations, and as required by recent EU rules.
q: Article 83bis allows the state of registration to tackle this problem by transferring oversight powers and responsibilities to the state where the leased aircraft is actually operated.

Artikel 83bis biedt de staat van registratie de mogelijkheid dit probleem het hoofd te bieden door de toezichtbevoegdheden en verantwoordelijkheden over te dragen aan de staat waar het verhuurd luchtvaartuig daadwerkelijk geëxploiteerd wordt.
p: Article 7.7 lets the executive conclude agreements transferring aviation safety oversight to another state, with a prior evaluation of norms as the only stated safeguard and no parliamentary approval of the agreements.

parties: Asks why the Chicago Convention article, ratified in 1981, is only now deemed necessary to implement in national law and what prompted it.
For what reasons is this now considered necessary?
Om welke redenen wordt dit nu wel nodig geacht?
Asks about consequences in relation to Brexit and Gibraltar, leasing of aircraft by Dutch firms, and timing of notification to ICAO.
They therefore would like to know when the Netherlands will ensure notification to the International Civil Aviation Organization.
Daarom vernemen zij graag wanneer Nederland voor notificatie aan de Internationale Burgerluchtvaartorganisatie zorg zal dragen.

Argues the bill should help reduce flights given climate, safety and environmental pressures, and asks whether foreign-registered aircraft will fall under Dutch oversight with adequate staffing and no lower emission or noise norms.

Can the government rule out that, as a result of this amendment, lower standards on greenhouse gas, particulate, other harmful substance and noise emissions will be applied in future to aircraft active in the Netherlands?

Kan de regering uitsluiten dat er, als gevolg van deze wetswijziging, in de toekomst met lagere normen op het gebied van de uitstoot van broeikasgassen, fijnstof, overige schadelijke stoffen en geluid zal worden gewerkt voor vliegtuigen die in Nederland actief zijn?

35470-I.s: This bill amends the 2019 state budget of the King (Slotwet), adjusting appropriations and realised figures for the non-policy articles covering the constitutional allowance to members of the Royal House, functional expenditure, and charged expenditure from other budgets. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
35470-I.j: The memorandum explains that the expenditure variance is due to collective labour agreement effects on constitutional allowances being lower than assumed in the original budget.
q: The expenditure variance is explained by the effect of the collective labour agreement for the central government sector on the constitutional allowances.
De uitgavenmutatie wordt verklaard door de doorwerking van de cao voor de sector Rijk naar de grondwettelijke uitkeringen.

35650-I.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 budget of the King's household (begrotingsstaat van de Koning) by small adjustments to functional expenditure and to cross-charged expenses from other budgets, with a net change of minus 80 thousand euro. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and applies retroactively from 1 December 2020.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the King (I) for the year 2020
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2020

35830-I.s: This budget-amendment bill (Slotwet) adjusts the 2020 budget of the King's household (begrotingsstaat van de Koning) by recording final realised spending, revenue and budget differences across its three non-policy articles. The explanatory memorandum explains the increase in the constitutional allowance to members of the Royal House as the result of tax and premium measures and higher wage increases than budgeted.
35830-I.j: The memorandum justifies the budget differences by pointing to tax and premium measures and collective wage agreement effects that were not foreseen when the budget was drawn up.
q: The development of the net salary of the vice-president of the Council of State is higher in 2020 than assumed when the budget was drawn up, due to tax and premium measures.

De ontwikkeling van de netto bezoldiging van de vicepresident van de Raad van State is als gevolg van belasting- en premiemaatregelen in 2020 hoger dan bij de opstelling van de begroting werd verondersteld.

36000.s: The bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (second supplementary budget on adjusting support measures), raising obligations by 600,000 thousand euro and expenditure by 475,000 thousand euro, mainly under the innovation and entrepreneurship policy article. It sets the budget unit in thousands of euro and makes the law effective from 1 January 2022.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36350-K.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Defence Materiel Fund (DMF) by reducing expenditure and revenue by 446.3 million euros each, and reshuffles project budgets between phases. It is the first supplementary budget for 2023, to take effect the day after publication and retroactive to 1 June 2023.
q: With this bill it is proposed to reduce the 2023 expenditure budget of the Defence Materiel Fund (K) compared with the adopted budget by 446.3 million euros.

Met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld de uitgavenbegroting 2023 van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) ten opzichte van de vastgestelde begroting met een bedrag van € 446,3 miljoen te verlagen.

36360-J.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) for 2022 through a closing budget law (Slotwet), adjusting appropriations, expenditure and revenue figures across its articles. It contains only technical implementation, bookkeeping and audit-driven adjustments and does not delegate rule-making power or shift powers from parliament or courts to the executive.
36360-J.j: The explanatory memorandum says the adjustments are technical implementation, bookkeeping or audit-driven changes, with larger mutations already shared with parliament via letters.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes or changes arising from audit findings.
– In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevin dingen opgenomen;

36550-I.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2024 state budget of the King (budget chapter I), raising commitments and expenditure by 2,184 thousand euros, mainly for functional expenditure and charged-through costs from other budgets. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 June 2024.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the King (I) for the year 2024
Wijziging van de van de begrotingsstaat van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2024

36600-M.s: This bill sets the 2025 budget statement of the Klimaatfonds (Climate Fund), fixing expenditure and commitments in thousands of euros for climate-related policy articles such as nuclear energy, energy infrastructure, early-stage scaling, and industrial decarbonisation. The explanatory memorandum extract discusses supervision, budget oversight and parliamentary requests, but contains no new delegation of rule-making power.
q: Adopted budget statement of the Climate Fund (M) for the year 2025 (amounts x EUR 1,000)
Vastgestelde begrotingsstaat van het Klimaatfonds (M) voor het jaar 2025 (bedragen x € 1.000)

36613-I.s: The bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Royal Household (Koning I), raising the constitutional allowance paid to members of the Royal House and adjusting several functional and cross-charged expenditure lines. It is a budget adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
36613-I.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the CAO wage development for 2024-2025 under the Wet financieel statuut van het Koninklijk Huis, not by any new executive power.
q: Following the CAO wage development 2024-2025, the constitutional allowance to members of the Royal House for 2024 has been adjusted under the Financial Statute of the Royal House Act.

Naar aanleiding van de CAO ontwikkeling 2024–2025 is op grond van de Wet financieel statuut van het Koninklijk Huis de grondwettelijke uitkering aan de leden van het Koninklijk Huis voor het jaar 2024 bijgesteld.

36800-K.s: This bill establishes the 2026 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (DMF), setting appropriations in thousands of euros for materiel, infrastructure and IT. It is a budget law under Article 105 of the Constitution and contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2026 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bĳ deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the draft 2026 budget statute for the Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport only notes that the Afdeling has no objections to the budget proposals and that some budgets require amendments, referring to annexes.

36800-XXIII.s: The bill sets the 2026 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (article 31, energy supply and climate change mitigation) and the 2026 budget statement for the agencies, in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January of the budget year, or retroactively from 1 January if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2026 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (XXIII) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport announces only some technical amendments to several budgets, detailed in annexes, without addressing any substantive legal objection.

36820-I.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Dutch Crown (Koning I), adding €322 thousand to the household's expenditure through a September supplementary budget. Its explanatory memorandum only sets out budget changes for the Crown's functional expenditure and transferred costs, with no new delegations of rule-making power.
q: There are no changes for article 1.
Er zijn geen mutaties voor artikel 1.
